import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO
import System.Exit (exitFailure)
import System.IO (stderr)

import ExchangeAlgebra.Assist (explainJournalErrors)

import EmitCanonical

type MinBase    = HatBase AccountTitles
type MinJournal = Journal String MoneyDecimal MinBase

amounts :: [MoneyDecimal]
amounts = [1100, 1300, 1300, 3100, 1800, 5500, 5900, 5000, 2700, 2400,
           4600, 2100, 4600, 1000, 4500, 5100, 1800, 3500, 4800, 3300,
           5900, 5400, 4000, 3100, 4200, 3600, 4000, 2500, 1000, 900,
           3100, 3700, 2800, 3200, 3500, 4100, 1800, 4300, 1900, 2300,
           2200, 900, 1900, 2800, 1900, 1600, 4000, 4000, 3100, 4000,
           5100, 4300, 1900, 3600, 5800, 3400, 5500, 4100, 5600, 3100,
           5800, 4500, 3000, 3100, 3600, 1800, 5600, 3300, 5300, 5500,
           3700, 4900, 4100, 2300, 3900, 2500, 3900, 4000, 4000, 5800,
           3000, 5000, 3700, 3700, 3000, 4400, 5400, 4300, 5400, 3700,
           3900, 5000, 2200, 2800, 6000, 5200, 1800, 4700, 2500, 5700,
           3800, 2700, 2700, 5900, 5300, 4000, 4300, 4100, 4000, 4900,
           4700, 4500, 3400, 2700, 5400, 2100, 3900, 4000, 3100, 5100,
           4700, 1200, 5800, 6000, 2900, 5400, 800, 6000, 2000, 5500,
           1400, 1100, 4400, 4900, 1100, 2500, 4500, 2200, 5100, 1400,
           5600, 4100, 1600, 2500, 2300, 6000, 2100, 1100, 3500, 5300,
           5600, 1000, 1100, 3100, 3100, 1900, 2300, 5100, 900, 1300,
           1500, 1200, 900, 1000, 5400, 900, 3100, 2400, 1600, 6000,
           1800, 5500, 1900, 4100, 5200, 800, 3200, 4500, 1000, 5800,
           2300, 1700, 1000, 800, 3000, 4700, 4800, 5500, 5500, 1500,
           2600, 2900, 3900, 900, 2700, 3600, 4300, 5700, 4600, 5500]

entries :: [(String, [(Side, AccountTitles, MoneyDecimal)])]
entries = zipWith (\id amt -> (id, [(Debit, Cash, amt), (Credit, Sales, amt)]))
                (map (("t" ++) . show) [1..200])
                amounts

totalSum :: Integer
totalSum = round $ sum (map toDecimal amounts)

derivedValues :: [(String, Integer)]
derivedValues = [
  ("ledger.Cash.debits", totalSum),
  ("ledger.Cash.credits", 0),
  ("ledger.Cash.balance", totalSum),
  ("trial_balance.Cash", totalSum),
  ("ledger.Sales.debits", 0),
  ("ledger.Sales.credits", totalSum),
  ("ledger.Sales.balance", totalSum),
  ("trial_balance.Sales", totalSum),
  ("financial_statements.total_assets", totalSum),
  ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", 0),
  ("financial_statements.opening_equity", 0),
  ("financial_statements.total_equity", totalSum),
  ("financial_statements.total_revenue", totalSum),
  ("financial_statements.total_expenses", 0),
  ("financial_statements.net_income", totalSum),
  ("financial_statements.balance_check", 1)
  ]

main :: IO ()
main = case checkedJournal entries of
  Left errs -> TIO.hPutStrLn stderr (explainJournalErrors errs) >> exitFailure
  Right j   -> emitObject [
      ("journal", JournalComp (toAlg j)),
      ("derived", RawComp (jFlatNum derivedValues))
    ]

import ExchangeAlgebra.Convert.Checked (JournalError, checkedJournal)
import ExchangeAlgebra.Assist (explainJournalErrors)
import ExchangeAlgebra.Journal (Journal, toAlg)
import EmitCanonical
import qualified Data.List.NonEmpty as NE
import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO
import System.Exit (exitFailure)
import System.IO (stderr)

type MinBase    = HatBase AccountTitles
type MinTx      = Alg MoneyDecimal MinBase
type MinJournal = Journal String MoneyDecimal MinBase

main :: IO ()
main = do
  let amounts = [2300,4500,4200,1600,3100,4600,3800,4800,4500,1200,
                 4600,800,3800,2400,4300,2200,2000,5300,3800,4200,
                 4300,3800,3300,4800,1700,2200,4800,1700,4100,3200,
                 5500,800,5000,5700,1200,1800,5600,4500,1000,2700,
                 5700,900,6000,2500,3800,4600,5400,3200,5300,5800]
      total = sum amounts
      journalEntries = zipWith (\i amt -> ("sale" ++ show i, [(Debit, Cash, amt), (Credit, Sales, amt)])) [1..50] amounts
  case checkedJournal journalEntries of
    Left errs -> TIO.hPutStrLn stderr (explainJournalErrors errs) >> exitFailure
    Right j   -> let derivedMetrics = 
                      [ ("ledger.Cash.debits", total)
                      , ("ledger.Cash.credits", 0)
                      , ("ledger.Cash.balance", total)
                      , ("trial_balance.Cash", total)
                      , ("ledger.Sales.debits", 0)
                      , ("ledger.Sales.credits", total)
                      , ("ledger.Sales.balance", total)
                      , ("trial_balance.Sales", total)
                      , ("financial_statements.total_assets", total)
                      , ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", 0)
                      , ("financial_statements.opening_equity", 0)
                      , ("financial_statements.total_equity", total)
                      , ("financial_statements.total_revenue", total)
                      , ("financial_statements.total_expenses", 0)
                      , ("financial_statements.net_income", total)
                      , ("financial_statements.balance_check", 1)
                      ]
               in emitObject [ ("journal", JournalComp (toAlg j))
                             , ("derived", RawComp (jFlatNum derivedMetrics))
                             ]

import System.IO (stderr)

type MinBase    = HatBase AccountTitles
type MinJournal = Journal String MoneyDecimal MinBase

amounts :: [Integer]
amounts = [2300,4500,4200,1600,3100,4600,3800,4800,4500,1200,

total :: Integer
total = sum amounts

entries :: [(String, [(Side, AccountTitles, MoneyDecimal)])]
entries = zipWith (\i amt -> ("e" ++ show i, [(Debit, Cash, fromIntegral amt), (Credit, Sales, fromIntegral amt)]))
                 [1..50] amounts

journal :: Either (NE.NonEmpty (JournalError String MoneyDecimal)) MinJournal
journal = checkedJournal entries
